question:
Select the most appropriate pair of words to fill in the blanks.

Yesterday, he ________ pizza and ________ burgers in one go.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**ate**" is the past tense of **"eat,"** meaning to consume food. (खा लिया)
 
• In the context of the sentence, **"ate"** is the correct verb to describe the action of consuming both pizza and burgers.
 
• The other options: "**eight**" refers to the number 8 and is incorrect in this context. "**eight; ate**" and "**ate; eight**" are also incorrect, as the verb "ate" correctly fits both blanks.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Yesterday, he ate__ pizza and **__eight__** burgers in one go.*
